title: Texas Capital Named Official Banking Partner of Circuit of The Americas
summary: Expanded partnership builds on years of collaboration between two Texas institutions
body_markdown:
**Austin, TX – October 13, 2026 –** Circuit of The Americas announces Texas Capital as the Official Banking Partner of COTA, formalizing a relationship built over the past several years through event sponsorships, brand activations and financial services.


The new designation solidifies Texas Capital’s role within COTA’s sports and entertainment venue and builds on years of collaboration between the two organizations. It brings together COTA and one of the country’s fastest-growing financial services firms – both Texas-based institutions committed to creating lasting impact well beyond the state.


“COTA was built to bring the biggest moments in sports and entertainment to Texas, and Texas Capital understands the reach and impact of that platform,” said Bobby Epstein, Chairman of Circuit of The Americas. “They have been a trusted partner for years, and naming Texas Capital our Official Banking Partner is a natural next step in a relationship grounded in Texas, ambition and a shared commitment to delivering world-class experiences.”


COTA’s global stage continues to attract premium companies and brands looking to connect with fans through world-class sports, entertainment and hospitality. Texas Capital joins a growing roster of partners that recognize the value of aligning with one of Texas’ most prominent destinations.


“Texas Capital is honored to be the Official Banking Partner of COTA,” said Rob C. Holmes, Chairman, President & CEO of Texas Capital. “COTA has become a powerful engine for economic activity and a global destination that reflects the ambition of Texas. Our transformation into the only full-service financial services firm headquartered in Texas enables us to support visionaries like Bobby and organizations like COTA with strategic solutions that help fuel growth, create lasting impact and drive long-term success.”


The expanded partnership will come to life through COTA events, hospitality and brand activations throughout the year, further connecting Texas Capital with the audiences and experiences that make COTA one of the country’s premier sports and entertainment destinations.


For more information about Circuit of The Americas, visit[TheCircuit.com](https://circuitoftheamericas.com/) . To learn more about Texas Capital, visit[texascapital.com](https://texascapitalbank.com/) .


## About Circuit of the Americas


Circuit of The Americas is a premier destination for sports and entertainment. Located on more than 1,500 acres in Texas, COTA is the first and only purpose-built Formula 1 circuit in the United States and home to the Formula 1 United States Grand Prix, MotoGP, NASCAR, FIA World Endurance Championship and major concerts and events throughout the year. Since opening in 2012, COTA has welcomed millions of fans and some of the biggest names in motorsports and music, establishing itself as one of the country’s leading sports and entertainment destinations.

## About Texas Capital


Texas Capital Bancshares, Inc. (TXSE: TCBI), a member of the Russell 2000® Index and the S&P MidCap 400®, is the parent company of Texas Capital Bank (“TCB”). Texas Capital is the collective brand name for TCB and its separate, non-bank affiliates and wholly owned subsidiaries. Texas Capital is a full-service financial services firm that delivers customized solutions to businesses, entrepreneurs and individual customers. Founded in 1998, the institution is headquartered in Dallas with offices in Austin, Fort Worth, Houston, San Antonio, Chicago, Los Angeles and New York City, and has a network of clients across the country. With the ability to service clients through their entire lifecycles, Texas Capital has established commercial banking, consumer banking, corporate and investment banking and wealth management capabilities. All services are subject to applicable laws, regulations and service terms. Deposit and lending products and services are offered by TCB. For deposit products, member FDIC. For more information, please visit[texascapital.com](https://texascapitalbank.com/) .
